prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing. Create an ORIGINAL DiggerChain fantasy promo painting in the traditional heroic oil-painting style of Boris Vallejo, with the modeled paint, rich ultramarine/emerald/amber/crimson color masses and deliberate theatrical composition of his vintage paperback covers. Hand-painted idealized forms, warm sculptural light, softly brushed atmosphere, strong selected contours. Not photography, not a movie still, not CGI, not pixel art. These are NEW original scenes for our game, not reproductions of reference paintings.
REFERENCE ROLES: image 1 is our own Lore painting and establishes character identity ONLY: the white chestnut-haired male adventurer at the far left and the hooded half-skeletal keeper at the right. Do not include the three other friends. Image 2 is an official Boris Vallejo painting, used ONLY for oil-painting technique, palette and sculptural form. Image 3 is a COMPOSITION reference only: ignore its pixel art, logo, lettering and unrelated characters. No text, logo, signature or frame anywhere in the new painting.
Our hero Adrien: adult white man about 30, short chestnut hair, strong square jaw, determined human face, simple medieval-fantasy armor, a navy/pale cloak, crimson scarf, brass pickaxe. Dress him modestly with covered chest, long trousers, boots, bracers and shoulder protection. No exposed torso, no revealing costume.
Our keeper: ancient male in a flowing charcoal/violet hooded robe, half aged human face and half clean ivory skull, short grey beard, BOTH eyes glowing emerald green, bony hands. Keep him mysterious and powerful, not a crowned king. No gore, no sexualized figures, no nudity. Full-frame original painted fantasy, clear at social-media sizes, character forms large and expressive.

Very wide 3:1 horizontal banner for a social profile. A richly oil-painted original gothic cave-castle panorama: Adrien on the far left with lantern, brass pickaxe, navy cloak and crimson scarf; the keeper's hooded half-skeletal face and emerald eyes loom from the far-right shadows. In the center, a long descending stone bridge and candlelit arches vanish beneath the forest roots, with distant green crystals glimmering. Keep the main faces inside the outer thirds and give the central third quiet deep-violet atmosphere. The composition reference supplies ONLY the wide left/center/right balance, not its lettering, wolves, sculpted metal or border. No engraved UI panel, no logo, no text, no borders; it must remain a luminous Boris Vallejo-style FANTASY OIL PAINTING.
